periods.analysis: Q1 actions: Made 112 outreach contacts, fewer than planned because February ice storms cancelled two weeks of door-to-door visits. Built a contact list for Old Ferry Road senior housing with the Housing Authority. Partners: Harborview Housing Authority, faith partners.
periods.recommendations: Next quarter: Hire a second outreach worker and begin evening outreach to seaport night-shift workers.

periods.analysis: Q2 actions: Hired a second outreach worker in April, which lifted contacts to 164 and brought the strategy back on pace. Began evening outreach to seaport night-shift workers alongside clinic staff. Partners: Harborview Housing Authority, Seaport Workers Clinic, faith partners.
periods.recommendations: Next quarter: Recruit a friendly-caller volunteer list and add a short isolation check-in to every home visit.

periods.analysis: Q3 actions: Outreach staff made 231 targeted contacts, up from 164 in Q2, concentrating on Old Ferry Road senior housing and seaport night-shift workers. Launched a friendly-caller list of 40 volunteers and began a short isolation check-in at every home visit. Partners: Harborview Housing Authority, Seaport Workers Clinic, faith partners.
periods.recommendations: Next quarter: Train the friendly-caller volunteers on referral steps, and add Seagrove senior buildings to the outreach route before winter.
